title.zh: 归并改变时，哪些选择仍可表达与执行
title.en: Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes

statement.en: Every selection through an old lumping, an equivalence, is expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old; a stock run with a process executes exactly the courses the stock covers and the process admits; in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart.
statement.zh: 旧归并为等价关系时，经它的每个选择都能经新归并表达，恰当新的不可分辨蕴含旧的；存量与一个过程联合运行时，所执行的恰是存量覆盖且该过程容许的历程；在 Revising 中，区分、支持与执行彼此分开。

laws.en: For a reflexive, symmetric and transitive old relation and any new relation on the same alternatives, every selection through the old relation (alike alternatives selected alike) is through the new one exactly where every pair the new relation makes alike the old one makes alike.
laws.zh: 旧关系自反、对称、传递，新关系任意，二者在同一替代项上：每个经旧关系的选择（相似者同选）都经新关系，恰当新关系视为相似的每一对旧关系也视为相似。

laws.en: For a reflexive, symmetric and transitive old relation, a pair the new relation makes alike and the old one tells apart gives a selection through the old relation that is not through the new one, constructively.
laws.zh: 旧关系自反、对称、传递时，新关系视为相似而旧关系区分的一对，给出一个经旧关系而不经新关系的选择，构造地成立。

laws.en: Lumping by an old and a fresh reading taken together makes alike only what the old reading makes alike; where the old reading agrees on two alternatives and the fresh one tells them apart, some selection is through the retained pair of readings and not through the old reading.
laws.zh: 按旧读取与新读取合在一起归并，只把旧读取视为相同者视为相同；旧读取在两个替代项上一致而新读取区分它们时，有一个选择经保留的读取对而不经旧读取。

laws.en: A lumping at each configuration keeps the distinctions from s to t where whatever t's lumping makes alike s's makes alike; keeping is reflexive and transitive, and where every step of a process keeps them, every trace keeps them from its start to its end and every run from each step n to every step n + k.
laws.zh: 各构型处的归并从 s 到 t 保留区分，是指 t 处归并视为相似者 s 处也视为相似；保留自反且传递；过程的每一步都保留时，每条轨迹从起点到终点保留，每次运行从第 n 步到第 n+k 步保留。

laws.en: For a web, a formation f, two couplings and steps t and u, every selection through f's first couplings up to t is through its second couplings up to u exactly where level histories alike through the second up to u are alike through the first up to t.
laws.zh: 对一个网、构成 f、两组耦合与步 t、u：每个直到 t 经 f 第一组耦合的选择都直到 u 经第二组耦合，恰当直到 u 经第二组相似的层级历史直到 t 经第一组也相似。

laws.en: Along a run, alternatives are alike up to step t where the lumping at every step through t makes them alike; alike up to a later step implies alike up to an earlier one, so a selection through the run's lumpings up to t is through them up to every later step.
laws.zh: 沿一次运行，两个替代项直到第 t 步相似，是指直到 t 的每一步的归并都视其为相似；直到较晚步相似蕴含直到较早步相似，所以直到 t 经运行诸归并的选择，直到每个较晚步仍经之。

laws.en: For any process with a natural-number stock and natural-number draws and replenishments of its acts, the stock is balanced where across every step what stands after plus the draw equals what stood before plus the replenishment; it is balanced exactly where along every course what stands at the end plus the total drawn equals what stood at the start plus the total replenished.
laws.zh: 对任一过程，存量与各动作的汲取、补充都是自然数：每一步之后所存加汲取等于之前所存加补充，存量即平衡；平衡恰当沿每个历程终点所存加总汲取等于起点所存加总补充。

laws.en: Stock n covers a course where each step's draw is within the stock then standing. The stock process, each step drawing at most what is held and then replenishing, executes a course from n exactly where n covers it; and every course of a process whose stock is balanced and drawn only from what is held before each step is covered by the stock it starts from.
laws.zh: 存量 n 覆盖一个历程，是指每步汲取都在当时所存之内。存量过程每步汲取不超过所持再补充，从 n 执行一个历程恰当 n 覆盖它；存量平衡且每步只从此前所持汲取的过程，其每个历程都被起始存量覆盖。

laws.en: Run jointly with any process R step for step, the stock process executes a course from stock n and configuration x exactly where n covers the course and R can execute it from x.
laws.zh: 存量过程与任一过程 R 逐步联合运行时，从存量 n 与构型 x 执行一个历程，恰当 n 覆盖该历程且 R 能从 x 执行它。

laws.en: Revising's configurations are a stock, a link and a response; replenishing adds one unit, rebuilding sets the link either way for one unit, and correcting, with the link formed, sets the response to the supplied target true for one unit. Each act leads to at most one configuration; rebuilding is enabled exactly where the stock is positive, correcting exactly where the link is formed too.
laws.zh: Revising 的构型是存量、关联与回应；补充加一单位，重构以一单位把关联设为任一方式，纠正在关联已形成时以一单位把回应设为给定目标 true。每个动作至多到一个构型；重构可行恰当存量为正，纠正可行恰当关联已形成且存量为正。

laws.en: Revising is the stock process run jointly, step for step, with its link process, rebuilding and correcting drawing one unit and replenishing restoring one; so its stock is balanced and drawn only from what is held, and a course of reconstruction and correction is executable exactly where the stock covers it and the link process admits it.
laws.zh: Revising 就是存量过程与其关联过程逐步联合运行，重构与纠正各汲取一单位，补充恢复一单位；所以其存量平衡且只从所持汲取，重构与纠正的历程可执行，恰当存量覆盖它且关联过程容许它。

laws.en: In Revising, stock does not enact and the link does not enact: one unit covers a correction that the link process blocks with the link unformed, and the link process admits a correction with the link formed that no stock covers from zero.
laws.zh: 在 Revising 中，存量不执行，关联也不执行：一单位存量覆盖一次纠正，而关联未形成时关联过程阻断它；关联已形成时关联过程容许一次纠正，而存量为零时没有存量覆盖它。

laws.en: In Revising, reading a represented alternative through the link, at configurations with response false and any stock: going from the link unformed to the link formed keeps every old distinction; with the link formed the selection 'is true' is through the lumping, with it unformed it is not, and the unformed lumping cannot select between the two rebuild modes.
laws.zh: 在 Revising 中经关联读取所表示的替代项，在回应为 false、存量任意的构型上：从关联未形成到关联已形成，保留每个旧区分；关联已形成时选择“为 true”经该归并，未形成时不经；未形成的归并不能在两种重构方式之间选择。

laws.en: In Revising, forming a distinction need not leave support to use it: rebuilding the link from one unit forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled, from two units leaves it enabled; and rebuilding the link away from two units loses that selection and leaves correction disabled with one unit left.
laws.zh: 在 Revising 中，形成区分不必留下使用它的支持：从一单位重构关联，形成选择“为 true”而纠正不可行，从两单位则仍可行；从两单位拆除关联，失去该选择，剩一单位而纠正不可行。

laws.en: A supplied controller reading the stock and the link (replenish when empty, form a missing link when supported, otherwise correct) runs Revising from no stock, no link and response false: it forms the link at step 1, at step 2 the finer lumping selects 'is true' with correction disabled, it replenishes, and step 3 corrects the response to true. Some admissible course forms the link and then removes it.
laws.zh: 给定控制器读取存量与关联（空则补充，有支持时形成缺失的关联，否则纠正），从无存量、无关联、回应 false 运行 Revising：第 1 步形成关联，第 2 步较细的归并选出“为 true”而纠正不可行，于是补充，第 3 步把回应纠正为 true。有一条可容许历程先形成关联再拆除它。

hypotheses.zh: 一般等价条件明示；过程、替代项域与各配置的归并给定。Trace 接续定理要求所述每一步保留区分，不宣称所有修改都如此。
hypotheses.en: Old reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity are explicit. The process, alternative domain and the lumping at each configuration are supplied. The trace theorem requires preservation at the stated steps, rather than claiming every revision preserves distinctions.

hypotheses.zh: 局部实例给定支持补充、两种重构、装置与读取的对应、目标 true 及偏好重建设备的控制律。全状态中的支持量与装置状态参与控制；控制不是只经把两种重构归为一类的初始读取来选择。
hypotheses.en: The instance supplies replenishment, two rebuild modes, apparatus-to-reading correspondence, target true and a controller preferring reconstruction. Stock and apparatus status enter control; reconstruction is not chosen solely through the initial reading, which lumps the two modes.
Stocks, draws and replenishments are natural numbers and courses are finite lists of acts; Revising's link and response are Boolean coordinates of one configuration, and its target true is supplied.
hypotheses.zh: 存量、汲取与补充是自然数，历程是有限的动作列表；Revising 的关联与回应是同一构型的布尔坐标，目标 true 是给定的。

hypotheses.en: No normative premise is assumed, nor that every act draws on the stock: replenishing draws nothing.
hypotheses.zh: 没有规范前提，也不假定每个动作都汲取存量：补充不汲取。

does_not_show.en: The criterion concerns keeping every old selection, more than keeping one useful response, and states no requirement to retain every distinction.
does_not_show.zh: 该条件关于保留全部旧选择，强于保留某个有用回应，并不要求保留每个区分。

does_not_show.en: The controller's preference for reconstruction, an acquired recipe, open invention of candidates, actual reliability of observation and warrant for the target do not follow from these laws.
does_not_show.zh: 控制器对重构的偏好、取得的配方、开放的候选发明、实际观察的可靠性与目标的正当性，都不由这些规律得出。

does_not_show.en: No composition in one history with the older material model, general asymptotic attraction or universal corrigibility is shown.
does_not_show.zh: 未表明与旧材料模型在同一历史中的组合、一般渐近吸引或普遍可纠正性。

does_not_show.en: That a selection is expressible through a lumping does not make an actual decoding of it correct.
does_not_show.zh: 选择能经某个归并表达，不使对它的实际解码正确。

does_not_show.en: The run's history of lumpings is defined of the run, not retained by it: an actual memory that keeps it and effects the model leaves out are not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 运行的归并史是就运行定义的，不是由运行保留的：保留它的实际记忆与模型略去的效应都未表明。

detail.zh: opens_without_correction：形成区分却耗尽行动支持。closes_choice：支持尚存但关闭关系使旧选择不可表达。old_cannot_select_rebuild：初始读取不能单独区分两个重构模式。 作为规律：covered_not_enacted 是存量覆盖而关联过程阻断的修正，linked_not_enacted 是关联容许而没有存量的修正。
detail.en: opens_without_correction gains a distinction while exhausting action support; closes_choice loses an old selection despite remaining stock; old_cannot_select_rebuild shows the initial reading alone cannot distinguish reconstruction modes. As laws: covered_not_enacted is a correction the stock covers and the link process blocks, and linked_not_enacted one the link admits with no stock to cover it.

correspondence.en: This connects the existing common-organization study to the spine. Lumping, selection, support and response are differentiated relations of one process; the local tuple preserves only the stated connections. Empty Lean axiom reports do not discharge substantive construction laws or the target. Apparatus formation, retained record, expressible choice and actual execution are kept apart.
correspondence.zh: 这把原共同组织研究接入主干。归并、选择、支持和回应是同一过程中的分化关系；局部元组只保留所论连接。空 Lean 公理报告不消除构造律和目标等实质前提。形成装置、保留记录、可表达的选择与实际执行彼此分开。
